# MyTickets Tours — full reference for AI assistants

> Independent guide to international sports and concert tickets in Portuguese, English and Spanish. MyTickets Tours is not a box office, organiser or venue operator. Tickets are sold and delivered by the partner  (, ), which works in the resale market; prices can be above or below face value. MyTickets Tours earns an affiliate commission at no extra cost to the buyer.

## How buying works

1. Pick the event on MyTickets Tours and read its guide (date, local time, venue, how to get there, seating tips).
2. The ticket button opens the same event at , in the visitor's language; the section and final price are shown before payment.
3. Payment, delivery and support are handled by  under its terms:  (checked 2026-11-04).
4. Emergency line of the partner on event day: .

Site languages: Portuguese (https://mytickets.tours/), English (https://mytickets.tours/en/), Spanish (https://mytickets.tours/es/).

## Events

### Italy vs France

- Date: Thursday, November 12, 2026, 20:45 local time
- Venue: San Siro (Giuseppe Meazza), Piazzale Angelo Moratti, Milan, Italy
- Competition: UEFA Nations League
- Teams: Italy vs France
- About: Two World Cup-winning nations meet at San Siro in the UEFA Nations League.
- Getting there: Metro M5 to San Siro Stadio station, next to the stadium. Night internationals pack the metro after the final whistle. It pays to wait 20 minutes.
- Guide pages: pt-BR https://mytickets.tours/eventos/italia-vs-franca-2026-11-12/, en https://mytickets.tours/en/events/italia-vs-franca-2026-11-12/, es https://mytickets.tours/es/eventos/italia-vs-franca-2026-11-12/

### England vs Croatia

- Date: Thursday, November 12, 2026, 19:45 local time
- Venue: Wembley Stadium, Wembley, London, England
- Competition: UEFA Nations League
- Teams: England vs Croatia
- About: England face Croatia at Wembley in the UEFA Nations League.
- Getting there: Underground to Wembley Park (Jubilee or Metropolitan line), then walk up Olympic Way. Chiltern Railways from Marylebone to Wembley Stadium station, next to the ground.
- Guide pages: pt-BR https://mytickets.tours/eventos/inglaterra-vs-croacia-2026-11-12/, en https://mytickets.tours/en/events/inglaterra-vs-croacia-2026-11-12/, es https://mytickets.tours/es/eventos/inglaterra-vs-croacia-2026-11-12/

### France vs South Africa

- Date: Friday, November 13, 2026, 21:10 local time
- Venue: Stade de France, ZAC du Cornillon Nord, Paris, France
- Competition: World Rugby Nations Championship
- Teams: France vs South Africa
- About: Test rugby at the Stade de France: France host South Africa in the World Rugby Nations Championship.
- Getting there: RER D to Stade de France–Saint-Denis or RER B to La Plaine–Stade de France. Metro line 13 to Saint-Denis–Porte de Paris, a few minutes' walk away.
- Guide pages: pt-BR https://mytickets.tours/eventos/franca-vs-africa-do-sul-2026-11-13/, en https://mytickets.tours/en/events/franca-vs-africa-do-sul-2026-11-13/, es https://mytickets.tours/es/eventos/franca-vs-africa-do-sul-2026-11-13/

### Mexico vs Jamaica

- Date: Tuesday, November 17, 2026, 20:30 local time
- Venue: Estadio BBVA, Av. Pablo Livas 2011, Monterrey, Mexico
- Competition: CONCACAF Nations League
- Teams: Mexico vs Jamaica
- About: Mexico host Jamaica at Estadio BBVA in Guadalupe, in the Monterrey area, in the CONCACAF Nations League.
- Getting there: The stadium is in Guadalupe, in the Monterrey metro area. A taxi or ride-hailing app is the simplest way in. Demand for rides is high after the match: agree a pickup point in advance.
- Guide pages: pt-BR https://mytickets.tours/eventos/mexico-vs-jamaica-2026-11-17/, en https://mytickets.tours/en/events/mexico-vs-jamaica-2026-11-17/, es https://mytickets.tours/es/eventos/mexico-vs-jamaica-2026-11-17/

### Ireland vs South Africa

- Date: Saturday, November 21, 2026, 16:40 local time
- Venue: Aviva Stadium, Lansdowne Road, Dublin, Ireland
- Competition: Nations Championship
- Teams: Ireland vs South Africa
- About: Ireland host South Africa at the Aviva Stadium in Dublin in the 2026 Nations Championship.
- Getting there: DART train to Lansdowne Road station, right next to the stadium. The station gets very busy on match day: arrive with time to spare.
- Guide pages: pt-BR https://mytickets.tours/eventos/ireland-vs-south-africa-2026-11-21/, en https://mytickets.tours/en/events/ireland-vs-south-africa-2026-11-21/, es https://mytickets.tours/es/eventos/ireland-vs-south-africa-2026-11-21/

### Formula 1 Abu Dhabi Grand Prix

- Date: Sunday, December 6, 2026, 14:00 local time
- Venue: Yas Marina Circuit, Yas Island, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
- Competition: Formula 1
- About: The final round of the Formula 1 season, a race that starts at dusk and finishes under the Yas Marina floodlights.
- Getting there: The circuit is on Yas Island, about 30 minutes by car from central Abu Dhabi. Organizers usually run shuttle buses on race weekend. Check the official GP site.
- Guide pages: pt-BR https://mytickets.tours/eventos/gp-abu-dhabi-f1-2026-12-06/, en https://mytickets.tours/en/events/gp-abu-dhabi-f1-2026-12-06/, es https://mytickets.tours/es/eventos/gp-abu-dhabi-f1-2026-12-06/

### FC Barcelona vs Manchester City

- Date: Tuesday, December 8, 2026, 21:00 local time
- Venue: Camp Nou, C. d'Arístides Maillol, 12, Barcelona, Spain
- Competition: UEFA Champions League
- Teams: FC Barcelona vs Manchester City
- About: Champions League night at Camp Nou: Barcelona host Manchester City.
- Getting there: Metro L3 to Les Corts or Palau Reial, or L5 to Collblanc or Badal. Champions League games are on weeknights. Book a hotel near a metro line.
- Guide pages: pt-BR https://mytickets.tours/eventos/barcelona-vs-manchester-city-2026-12-08/, en https://mytickets.tours/en/events/barcelona-vs-manchester-city-2026-12-08/, es https://mytickets.tours/es/eventos/barcelona-vs-manchester-city-2026-12-08/

### Los Angeles Lakers vs Boston Celtics

- Date: Thursday, January 7, 2027, 19:00 local time
- Venue: Crypto.com Arena, 1111 S. Figueroa St, Los Angeles, USA
- Competition: NBA
- Teams: Los Angeles Lakers vs Boston Celtics
- About: The NBA's biggest rivalry: the Lakers host the Celtics at Crypto.com Arena in Los Angeles.
- Getting there: Metro A and E Lines to Pico station, a few minutes' walk from the arena. Doors usually open one hour before tip-off.
- Guide pages: pt-BR https://mytickets.tours/eventos/lakers-vs-celtics-2027-01-07/, en https://mytickets.tours/en/events/lakers-vs-celtics-2027-01-07/, es https://mytickets.tours/es/eventos/lakers-vs-celtics-2027-01-07/

### New York Knicks vs Denver Nuggets

- Date: Monday, January 11, 2027, 19:30 local time
- Venue: Madison Square Garden, 4 Pennsylvania Plaza, New York, USA
- Competition: NBA
- Teams: New York Knicks vs Denver Nuggets
- About: NBA at Madison Square Garden, basketball's most famous arena, with the Knicks hosting the Nuggets.
- Getting there: The arena sits above Penn Station: subway 1, 2, 3, A, C and E to 34 St–Penn Station. Doors usually open one hour before tip-off.
- Guide pages: pt-BR https://mytickets.tours/eventos/knicks-vs-nuggets-2027-01-11/, en https://mytickets.tours/en/events/knicks-vs-nuggets-2027-01-11/, es https://mytickets.tours/es/eventos/knicks-vs-nuggets-2027-01-11/

### NBA Manchester Game: Pelicans vs Spurs

- Date: Sunday, January 17, 2027, 15:30 local time
- Venue: Co-op Live, 1 Sports City Way, Manchester, United Kingdom
- Competition: NBA
- Teams: New Orleans Pelicans vs San Antonio Spurs
- About: A regular-season NBA game in Europe: New Orleans Pelicans vs San Antonio Spurs at Co-op Live in Manchester.
- Getting there: Metrolink tram to the Etihad Campus stop, next to the arena. The arena is on the same campus as Manchester City's stadium.
- Guide pages: pt-BR https://mytickets.tours/eventos/nba-manchester-pelicans-vs-spurs-2027-01-17/, en https://mytickets.tours/en/events/nba-manchester-pelicans-vs-spurs-2027-01-17/, es https://mytickets.tours/es/eventos/nba-manchester-pelicans-vs-spurs-2027-01-17/

### Australian Open Men's Final

- Date: Sunday, January 31, 2027, 19:30 local time
- Venue: Rod Laver Arena, Olympic Blvd, Melbourne Park, Melbourne, Australia
- Competition: Australian Open (Grand Slam)
- About: The men's final of the year's first Grand Slam, on the main court at Melbourne Park.
- Getting there: Rod Laver Arena is in Melbourne Park, about a 15-minute walk from Flinders Street station. Extra trams run to Melbourne Park during the tournament. Check times on the Australian Open site.
- Guide pages: pt-BR https://mytickets.tours/eventos/final-australian-open-2027-01-31/, en https://mytickets.tours/en/events/final-australian-open-2027-01-31/, es https://mytickets.tours/es/eventos/final-australian-open-2027-01-31/

### Foo Fighters in São Paulo

- Date: Saturday, February 20, 2027, 20:00 local time
- Venue: MorumBis, Praça Roberto Gomes Pedrosa, 1, São Paulo, Brazil
- Artist: Foo Fighters
- About: Foo Fighters bring the Take Cover Tour to MorumBis in São Paulo. The band also plays Arena MRV in Belo Horizonte on February 18.
- Getting there: São Paulo–Morumbi station on Metro Line 4-Yellow is the closest; there is still a walk to the stadium. Trains and ride apps are packed after the show: plan your way back in advance.
- Guide pages: pt-BR https://mytickets.tours/eventos/foo-fighters-sao-paulo-2027-02-20/, en https://mytickets.tours/en/events/foo-fighters-sao-paulo-2027-02-20/, es https://mytickets.tours/es/eventos/foo-fighters-sao-paulo-2027-02-20/

### U2 in Mexico City

- Date: Tuesday, February 23, 2027, 21:00 local time
- Venue: Estadio GNP Seguros, Viaducto Piedad y Río Churubusco s/n, Ciudad Deportiva, Mexico City, Mexico
- Artist: U2
- About: U2 open the Mexico City run of The Greatest Show On Earth tour at Estadio GNP Seguros. More dates follow on February 26 and 28 and March 2.
- Getting there: Metro Line 9 to Ciudad Deportiva station, next to the stadium. The metro is packed after the show: have a plan B for getting back.
- Guide pages: pt-BR https://mytickets.tours/eventos/u2-cidade-do-mexico-2027-02-23/, en https://mytickets.tours/en/events/u2-cidade-do-mexico-2027-02-23/, es https://mytickets.tours/es/eventos/u2-cidade-do-mexico-2027-02-23/

### Celine Dion in Paris

- Date: Friday, May 14, 2027, 19:30 local time
- Venue: Paris La Défense Arena, 99 Jardin de l'Arche, Paris, France
- Artist: Celine Dion
- About: Celine Dion performs at Paris La Défense Arena. The partner also lists a second date the next day, May 15.
- Getting there: RER A, metro line 1 or tram T2 to La Défense–Grande Arche. The arena is about a 10-minute walk from the station.

### 2027 Champions League Final

- Date: Saturday, June 5, 2027, 21:00 local time
- Venue: Estadio Metropolitano, Av. de Luis Aragonés, 4, Madrid, Spain
- Competition: UEFA Champions League
- About: The 2027 Champions League final is at the Estadio Metropolitano in Madrid. The finalists are not decided yet.
- Getting there: Metro line 7 to Estadio Metropolitano station, right outside the stadium. Arrive two hours early for a final. Security and queues are long.
- Guide pages: pt-BR https://mytickets.tours/eventos/final-champions-league-2027-06-05/, en https://mytickets.tours/en/events/final-champions-league-2027-06-05/, es https://mytickets.tours/es/eventos/final-champions-league-2027-06-05/
